title: Ultrahuman product band
description: A product band with a 40px name over a grey tagline, then on desktop a sticky left column (rounded media, the name in 32px and two pills) beside a stack of 16px-radius cards: a big statement, a centred figure ("Up to / 40 Days" or a ~150px bare number), and a mono-titled feature list with icons and hairline rules. On phones it stacks, and the name with its two buttons rides as a bar pinned to the bottom of the window for the length of the band. Cards and list rows rise in on scroll. Black with charcoal cards, or white with pale grey cards.
notes: tone dark forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class; tone light uses the page colours
two bands in a row hand the phone bar over from one to the next as they scroll
